summary: A stop-loss limit order on the NRML (Arrow M) product: the stream says SL-LMT and M, as the order was placed; the desktop maps them as every Arrow order book does (SL, NRML), the web's order stream passes SL-LMT through and calls M intraday.

notes: The web places SL as SL-LMT and SL-M as SL-MKT, and NRML as M (transform_data.py:19-29), and its own order book maps them back the same way (order_data.py:12-13, transform_data.py:35).

deviations.reason: The web places SL as Arrow's SL-LMT and reads SL-LMT back as SL in its order book, but its order stream passes SL-LMT through, which is not an OpenAlgo price type; the desktop maps it as the order book does.
deviations.ref: arrow_order_adapter.py:42 (_PRICETYPE_MAP has no SL-LMT or SL-MKT); broker/arrow/mapping/order_data.py:12-13

deviations.reason: Arrow's M is NRML everywhere the web maps it for placing and for its order book (transform_data.py:28, 35); the web's order stream alone calls it MIS, so an NRML order's updates name the wrong product. The desktop keeps NRML (audit RB-14).
